[LTES.2.4.2]

| Test shape | Example |
|---|---|
| Positive: scenario → expected reaction | feed facts + mocked adapter state, confirm `call` / `emit` happens |
| Negative: scenario → no reaction | confirm rule does *not* fire under wrong conditions |
| Temporal: time-dependent behaviour | "5 minutes after last motion, lights turn off" |

A further shape is [LTES.2.4.4]'s.
